title: The document is saved, but where is its movement?
goal: Add a teaching labor-turnover register in a copy and verify ordinary writing, posting and unposting for one own recorder.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P4. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: A 30-minute request exists in the list. Does accounting already include 30 minutes of work? Observe the document and register rows separately: saving, posting, and unposting create different states.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: The document is the recorder
paragraphs: A movement explains which document caused an accounting fact. A service desk can track minute obligations by customer. A record contains period, dimensions, resource and recorder. A document’sMinutes field is not itself a movement. Agree on sign and meaning before implementing a handler.

Posting is denied in the starter. In a new copy add accumulation register Трудозатраты with Turnovers kind, Клиент: CatalogRef.Клиенты dimension and Минуты: Number(15,2) resource. The existing document attribute remains ДлительностьМинут. The register resource is a distinct field; no populated header attribute must be renamed.

sections.title: Prepare the experiment while retaining P4
paragraphs: Continue your own P4 copy after preserving its DT and sources. Do not load a full configuration over prior work. If using the supplied training template, load service-desk-documents-v2 into a new separate infobase and distinguish it from your continuing work.

ЗаявкаУслуги needs Клиент, Услуга, Статус, ДлительностьМинут and Комментарий. ПередЗаписью must refuse missing customer/service/status and minutes outside 0…1440. Review the existing handler first; do not create another procedure of the same name.

For posting, add the missing accumulation register Трудозатраты in Designer: Turnovers, dimension Клиент of customer-reference type, resource Минуты Number(15,2), recorder ЗаявкаУслуги. Allow posting for the document and select this register under Движения. Preserve existing attributes and modules.

The separate source below belongs to the document OBJECT module, not the common module or application handler. Reconcile ПередЗаписью with existing code. Add the missing ОбработкаПроведения or reconcile the existing one: clear this document’s set, enable writing, and add its date, customer and minutes. Do not duplicate handlers.

sections.title: The complete function: what happens to the data
paragraphs: УчебныеДанные common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.
This is Данные.bsl for the common module. The separate application source below calls it. Do not paste both files into one editor.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: The query filters movements by the actual reference of this request only. Before posting there are 0 rows. Posting yields 1 row/30 minutes. Unposting returns to 0 rows while the document reference remains non-empty. Other training requests do not affect this observation.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: Rebuild the movement set
paragraphs: Build movements from current document data inPosting and control record-set writing. Reposting replaces that recorder’s effect rather than appending a duplicate. Changing 30 to 45 yields 45, not 75. Do not manually add the prior document amount to the new record set.

Allow document posting and select Трудозатраты among its register records. In ОбработкаПроведения clear this recorder’s collection, enable writing and add period from Дата, customer from Клиент and minutes from ДлительностьМинут. This clears the current document’s movement set, not the whole register. Keep the existing ПередЗаписью validation.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: A 45-minute request is reposted after changing it to 75. With movements rebuilt correctly, what total should this recorder have?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: One row of 75. The handler clears this document’s prior movement set and rebuilds it. Accumulating 45+75 would mean the old accounting effect was not replaced. A query checks this property; the Проведен flag alone does not.

sections.title: Reversal removes effects, not the document
paragraphs: After reversal, the document remains while its accounting effect is removed or compensated under the model. Metadata and handlers determine behavior. Inspect recorder-filtered records and register totals, not onlyPosted. A starter stand without posting needs a new versioned template for this exercise.

The function creates an own 30-minute request. An ordinary write gives zero movements filtered by its reference. Posting gives one row and 30 minutes. Unposting with automatic movement deletion removes those rows while retaining the document and reference. Новая is not a posting criterion. Test one recorder rather than the entire infobase’s accumulated total.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: At each node distinguish the document’s existence from its movements. The diagram shows the 30-minute worked example. The independent task additionally checks replacement of 45 with 75 on reposting.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: A faulty variant retains the old 45 and adds 75. Проведен remains true, but 120 is wrong. Another error is querying the whole register without filtering the request, then attributing unrelated minutes to it.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Rejection must be atomic
paragraphs: If required movement data is missing, reject before accepting effects. A negative case checks both document and movements. An unset flag with partially modified register data is not a correct rejection. Transactional checks cover every side effect, not one table alone.

The incorrect variant uses 31 minutes: it still creates a movement, but the independent 30-minute expectation rejects it. Do not adjust expected totals to follow a defect. This small teaching model does not establish statutory accounting, concurrent posting, reservation or industrial performance. Reposting is developed in the next module.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: Create and post a new 45-minute request; verify 1 row/45. Change that same request to 75 and repost:it must have 1 row/75, not 120. Unpost it:0 movements, the request and its reference remain.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.

paragraphs: УчебныеДанные common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.

Preserve the previous handler separately. Run the experiment once in your copy, compare labelled messages and specific new records, then remove only the added startup call. Do not delete records to match a screenshot.
